title: What bike mechanics do
d: Bicycle mechanics assemble, tune, and repair bikes: shifting, braking, wheels, bearings, and suspension. From flat fixes to full builds, it is precise mechanica
description: Bicycle mechanics assemble, tune, and repair bikes: shifting, braking, wheels, bearings, and suspension. From flat fixes to full builds, it is precise mechanical work with happy customers. Barnett or UBI school plus shop experience is the path.

title: Essential tools
d: Hex wrench set, Torx set, cable cutters, chain tool, chain whip and cassette lockring tool, cone wrenches, spoke wrench, pedal wrench, torque wrench, tire lever
description: Hex wrench set, Torx set, cable cutters, chain tool, chain whip and cassette lockring tool, cone wrenches, spoke wrench, pedal wrench, torque wrench, tire levers, floor pump, and a repair stand. Pros add: truing stand and bearing presses.

title: Key skills
d: Derailleur adjustment: limit screws, then cable tension. Brake setup: pad alignment and cable tension. Wheel truing: lateral, radial, dish. Bearing service: hub
description: Derailleur adjustment: limit screws, then cable tension. Brake setup: pad alignment and cable tension. Wheel truing: lateral, radial, dish. Bearing service: hubs, bottom brackets, headsets. Tubeless setup. Reading wear: chains, cassettes, brake pads.

title: Safety essentials
d: Torque carbon parts to spec — over-tightening cracks frames. Test brakes before every test ride. Stand stability: secure the bike. Chemical safety with degrease
description: Torque carbon parts to spec — over-tightening cracks frames. Test brakes before every test ride. Stand stability: secure the bike. Chemical safety with degreasers. Test ride carefully after major work.

title: Getting started
d: Work on your own bikes first, then volunteer at co-ops. Barnett Bicycle Institute or UBI for formal training. Start at a shop doing flats and tunes; build to wh
description: Work on your own bikes first, then volunteer at co-ops. Barnett Bicycle Institute or UBI for formal training. Start at a shop doing flats and tunes; build to wheels and suspension. E-bike certification is the growth area.

title: Pro tips
d: Clean the bike before diagnosing — grime hides problems. Replace cables and housing together. Measure chain wear; it saves cassettes. Document e-bike systems ca
description: Clean the bike before diagnosing — grime hides problems. Replace cables and housing together. Measure chain wear; it saves cassettes. Document e-bike systems carefully. A test ride is part of every repair.
